_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Hardness Data Manual (HDM) Update
summary: The Hardness Data Manual (HDM) Update DID specifies the format and content preparation instructions for updating an existing Hardness Data Manual to reflect hardness-related hardware changes on a contract.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract according to MIL-STD-1766C, 5.5.3.6.
This DID is applicable to system development contracts during the engineering and manufacturing development and production phases, and to other contracts where changes to hardness critical hardware are being made and that hardware has an existing Hardness Data Manual.
This DID is the original release (new). Comments, suggestions, or questions on this document should be addressed to the Defense Standardization Program Office (DSPO), 1551 Wyoming Blvd. SE Kirtland AFB, NM 87117-5624 or emailed to afnwc.dspo.workflow@us.af.mil. Since contact information can change, you may want to verify the currency of this address information using the ASSIST online database at https://assist.dla.mil.

references.label: SAE / EIA-649_1 Configuration Management Requirements for Defense Contracts

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report and all attachments shall be provided in Microsoft Word but follow the format of the existing Hardness Data Manual (HDM) that is being updated. Page size shall be 8 1/2 x 11 inches except where necessary, 11 x 17 inches may be used as a foldout. Security classification and distribution markings shall conform to the requirements of the contract, when applicable.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: Use version applicable on the data of contract award (which may require updating of links provided below).

children.title: SAE / EIA-649_1 Configuration Management Requirements for Defense Contracts

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report content shall preserve the existing HDM format and be as follows:

children.title: Title Page
children.content: Update the revision information and date to reflect the current update.

children.title: Table of Contents
children.content: Follow the existing format but add new content relevant to the current program and delete items for hardware that is no longer relevant.

children.title: Update the Introduction, Physical and Function
children.content: Descriptions, References Section, Hardness Critical Item List/Index, Hardness Requirements, Assessment, Design Criteria, Design Features, Hardness Design Evaluation, and Hardness Design Proof with content applicable to the current contract. Provide complete details that demonstrate the new hardware meets the requirements. The detailed tasks of MIL-STD-1766C, Section 5, provide insight into the type of content that is needed and shall guide the contractor's update.

children.title: In all sections, provide a complete
children.content: and detailed description of the analysis and test and hardware changes that resulted in the final delivered design hardware.

preparation_instructions.title: Submittal Instructions:
preparation_instructions.content: Use DD Form 1696 to prepare a Specification Change Notice as the cover page(s) to the HDM Update change pages or, if the update is simple and the government program office responsible for the HDM agrees, use AF Form 3925 to prepare an Engineering Order as the cover page(s) to the HDM Update change pages. Follow the Air Force process for specification changes IAW EIA-649 for specification changes (using the DD Form 1696) or for configuration data changes (AF Form 3925).
